projects.title: altfins: Crypto Monitoring & Telegram Alerts
projects.summary: Runs 24/7 to collect cryptocurrency analysis from altFINS, store structured data in Supabase, and deliver updates through Telegram.
projects.description: A Python automation service for monitoring cryptocurrency analysis without manually revisiting multiple altFINS pages. The service operates around the clock and sends source-specific updates to Telegram. Its pipeline separates browser automation, typed data models, persistence, and notification delivery so each part can be maintained independently.
highlights: Built a Playwright pipeline for Technical Analysis, Chart Patterns, and Market Highlights, with Pydantic models to normalize extracted records.
Persisted market indicators in Supabase and synchronized browser session state to reuse authenticated sessions across automated runs.
Added same-source and cross-source deduplication, database retries, and source-specific Telegram notifications.
Automated execution through GitHub Actions and an external scheduler; operated the service 24/7 for ongoing cryptocurrency updates.
